findings: PR #26's statement 'third-party descriptions say most series charge makers nothing, so 0.0175 is an upper bound' is true for 367/392 archived NFL-family series (fee_type quadratic = taker-only) but NOT for KXNFLGAME, KXNFLSPREAD, KXNFLTOTAL: the exchange itself labels them quadratic_with_maker_fees.

KXNFLGAME: maker multiplier 1.0 is listed in the attested schedule window => 0.0175 coefficient is the schedule-supported maker rate for 2026 games. The only fee_change record for it is effective 2026-01-01T08:00Z, so for the 2025 regular season the maker fee_type is not documented in this archive.
KXNFLSPREAD / KXNFLTOTAL: maker-fee type with NO listed maker multiplier => UNVERIFIED (fail closed); report the whole M0/M25/M100 range.
Taker 0.07 is empirically confirmed; no real maker fill exists, so no maker fee is OBSERVED anywhere.

KXNFLSPREAD.note: maker-fee series with no listed maker multiplier (fail closed)

KXNFLTOTAL.note: maker-fee series with no listed maker multiplier (fail closed)

not_in_archive.NBA: no fee archive for NBA series (only the NFL-family series list is captured) -> maker rate UNVERIFIED, scenarios only
